# SIA: Self-Improving Agent API

> A REST API for agents that learn a domain from answers, corrections and documents. What they learn is kept as readable text (lessons, a playbook, documents), not model weights. Bring your own model key; self-host with Docker.

Base URL: http://localhost:8000 when self-hosted (set SIA_URL); every endpoint below is under /v1.
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <SIA key>. Model calls also take X-LLM-Provider (default gemini; also anthropic, openai, groq, ollama, openrouter, together, mistral, deepseek), X-LLM-Key and optional X-LLM-Model. The model key is used per request and never stored.

## Core endpoints

- POST /v1/agents: create an agent {name, domain, instructions, rubric}
- POST /v1/agents/{id}/knowledge: add a document {title, content}
- POST /v1/agents/{id}/run: answer a task {task, learn?} -> {answer, score, episode_id, ...}
- POST /v1/agents/{id}/feedback: rate or correct an answer {episode_id, rating 1-5, correction?}
- POST /v1/agents/{id}/study: practise on generated questions {rounds}
- POST /v1/agents/{id}/improve: propose a new playbook, adopted only with a measured win {trials, activate?}
